prosePins.comment: stage 5 + cross-cutting (I9): checks assert structure, prose lives in goldens; the two added pins in cli-help and gate-dispatch assert the help renderer's own printed output (control-mcp's and remove-app's help) — the allowed renderer-output case.

proseMatchers.comment: stage 5 (design 5.1): prose in other operators — startsWith/endsWith/indexOf of a literal with a space, .match(/… …/), /…\s…/.test(, ===/!== with a literal with a space, includes() splitting a pin across a " + " string join — outside the single-literal pins counted by prosePins; equality: translation must not move a pin into another operator

proseEquality.comment: stage 5 + cross-cutting (I9): prose as the third argument of check(name, actual, "literal with a space") — a form prosePins (includes only) and proseMatchers (equality operator required) both miss, so rewriting a === pin into check() lowers proseMatchers while the prose stays; equality ratchet: growth fails, the existing sites are not being converted now

proseFlags.comment: stage 4 (design 2.3): a --name a declaration itself declares, spelled in its own details outside a token and outside a code span quoting another tool — each belongs in a {--name} token, so this counts down to 0

retiredSymbols.comment: stage 5 (rf5-completion C1/C3, rf5-mcp): names the command registry, the completion table and the declared-summary schema made structural that must not reappear anywhere under tools/ outside tools/checks/architecture/

adhocSkips.comment: invariant I10 (rf6-fix14): a host-dependent check case is skipped only through a declared capability (requires()); lines matching /process.platform|os.platform()|skip(/ under tools/checks (kit, architecture, golden excluded) must all sit on an exempt line — a recorded value selection, a transport helper kept for its probe, or a nested availability note inside a requires() body. total counts occurrences past the exemptions: any new ad-hoc gate fails, and an exempt line that disappears fails too
